title: The Truth About How Recruiters Review Resumes - Is The 7.4 Second Rule True?
description:
How do recruiters REALLY read resumes? Is it true that recruiters only spend 7.4 seconds on it? And what parts are most important? 

In this video, Teal's Director of Talent, Mike Peditto, breaks down what he looks for as a recruiter and what he suggests to make sure your resume makes it past the first round of review. 

00:00 Introduction
00:41 The truth about most job applicants
00:53 What do recruiters look for?
01:09 How recruiters know a resume's not right for the job
01:56 What stands out to a recruiter?
02:33 Relevant target title
02:54 Relevant achievements
03:40 Skills: Show don't tell
04:38 Professional summary: yes or no?
05:51 Wrap-up
